I've recorded Ilse's correction: the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is 10 June, not 25 November.

- **Brain:** I saved 10 June as a new fact on Brackenwater, noting that it corrects Ilse's #north-team post from this morning. I also withdrew the saved 25 November fact, so it won't come back up when someone asks about the renewal.
- **Reply:** I answered Ilse in a thread on their #north-random message to say the records are updated. A renewal date counts as an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it's fine to post where everyone in that channel can read it.

Ilse said no action was needed, so I didn't change their original #north-team post, contact anyone else, or send any mail.
